label: CCR1036-8G-2S+
description: MikroTik CCR1036-8G-2S+ - cloud core router: 8x 1G RJ45, 2x 10G SFP+ cages, 36-core TILE CPU, 4 GB RAM, dual PSU. Discontinued.
notes: MikroTik specification table: section Ethernet prints "10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 8", section Fiber prints "SFP+ ports: 2", section Peripherals prints "Serial console port: RJ45" and "Number of USB ports: 1". The product summary is "1U rackmount, 8x Gigabit Ethernet, 2xSFP+ cages, LCD, 36 cores x 1.2GHz CPU, 4GB RAM" and the page states "Supports both SFP (1.25G) and SFP+ (10G) modules", so the two cages carry speedCaps 1000/10000. The spec previously declared only the eight copper ports - the two SFP+ cages were not modelled at all, and it cited no source. Copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets. This spec had declared neither `l2-forward` nor `firewall`; the page's own throughput table carries "Bridging" rows and "Routing / 25 ip filter rules" rows, so both are now declared. No PoE in either direction. Model stays CCR1036 because that is the filename and the catalogue id; the SKU is on the label. Sources: https://mikrotik.com/product/CCR1036-8G-2Splus and https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/ccr1036-8g-2s-plus-series/
